_what: How a whole ad is made, as settings: the lanes a production can run in, the styles that are filmed pictures, and any format whose way of being made is fixed whatever footage we own. machine/lane.py is the only reader; the Video Studio shows its call and never decides one. Brand-agnostic.

lanes.mix: AI + Real (our footage where the footage decision passed the shot, AI for the rest)
lanes.real: Real (our own footage on every shot)
lanes.creator: A creator films it (the creator brief goes to the creator hub)

filmed_styles._what: Style ids whose pictures are filmed footage, so a clip of ours can be cut into them. Any other style is drawn or rendered in a look our filmed footage does not have, and every shot of it is made. No style on a run means photoreal.

by_format._what: A format made one way whatever the route and the footage say. Each row: the lane, the reason in plain words, where the reason comes from, and a status. Only a format whose own definition settles it belongs here; every other format is decided by the route and the footage decision (lane.py default).

text-thread.why: drawn in code: no people and no camera, so there is no shot footage of ours could stand in for

older_production._what: A production saved before the lane was recorded on it (before 2026-11-16). Those were all made the same way, so every reader gets the same answer.
older_production.why: made before the way of making was recorded on a production: those ran our own footage on every shot, with AI only on a yes
